hero.title: Savour Traditional Indian Delights at By 2 Coffee-Temple Meals
hero.subtitle: Experience the rich heritage of Indian cuisine and the comforting embrace of a shared coffee, a beloved Bengaluru tradition since 2012.

about.title: Our Story & Heritage
about.paragraph1: By 2 Coffee-Temple Meals is a vibrant celebration of the incredible flavors and rich heritage of ethnic Indian cuisine. With our time-honored recipes that tell the stories of Indian flavors, every bite is a testament to our love and commitment. Since our establishment in 2012, we have become a beloved name in Bengaluru, with many outlets and a loyal customer base.
about.paragraph2: Our journey began in 2012, born from the simple yet profound concept of 'By 2 Coffee' — a single cup shared between two. This isn't just a generic term for us; it's a trusted and beloved name, especially among traditional Idli-Vada and coffee lovers. At By 2 Coffee-Temple Meals, we take immense pride in our heritage and invite you to join us in savoring the delicious delights that truly embody the essence of Indian cuisine.
